title: Motion Branding / Header film
slide_intent: Give a familiar geometric element a recognizable rhythm so viewers can connect movement with the brand.
strategic_value: A repeated red sleeper sequence on Cold Black can make DB recognizable before any words appear.
demonstration: A wide dark video stage presents the red Schwelle as changing vertical bars. The PNG records one frame; the complete local film supplies the motion.
practical_value: Compare the whole header film with the individual motion rules below.
